title: Blow-up for energy supercritical defocusing nonlinear Schrödinger equations in dimensions three, four and five
summary: We prove finite time blow-up from smooth, radial, compactly supported initial data for the energy supercritical defocusing nonlinear Schrödinger equation $i\partial_tu+Δu-|u|^{p-1}u=0$ in $\mathbb R^d$, for $(d,p)\in\{(3,27),(4,9),(5,7)\}$. The solutions are asymptotically self-similar, their $L^\infty$ norm grows at the scaling rate $(T-t)^{-1/(p-1)}$, and their critical Sobolev norm $\dot H^{s_c}$ diverges. This closes the conjecture of Bourgain \cite{Bourgain2000} on global well-posedness and scattering for the defocusing energy supercritical equation in dimensions three and four. The…
